content.text: {"namespace":"ui","action":"set_widget_property","description":"Set a property on a widget (text, color, opacity, visibility, etc.). Default mode gates writes through the per-type curated allowlist; pass raw_mode=true to bypass the gate (legacy compat). The new value can be supplied as `value` OR the alias `property_value` (Bug #6 fix).","params":{"asset_path":{"type":"string","description":"Widget Blueprint asset path","required":true,"kind":"AssetPath"},"widget_name":{"type":"string","description":"Target widget name","required":true},"property_name":{"type":"string","description":"Property path. Dotted segments allowed (e.g. 'Padding.Left'). Allowlist-gated unless raw_mode=true.","required":true},"value":{"type":"string","description":"Property value (alias: 'property_value'). Strings, numbers, booleans, JSON arrays/objects all accepted; struct types (Vector2D/LinearColor/Margin/Vector4/SlateColor) accept multiple shapes.","required":true},"compile":{"type":"boolean","description":"Compile after setting","required":false,"default":"false"},"raw_mode":{"type":"boolean","description":"Bypass the allowlist gate (legacy unconditional ImportText_Direct path). Default false.","required":false,"default":"false"}}}
